perm_location_reason: CityTour uses your precise location to start a story when you reach a monument and to guide you to the next stop.
perm_background_reason: Keeps your guide talking while you explore, even with the screen off.
perm_vibrate_reason: A short vibration tells you that you have arrived at a stop.
label_simulated_a11y: Simulated location. Demo walk is on.
label_demo_walk_a11y: Simulated location. Demo walk is on. Opens demo controls.
home_demo_walk_hint: Replays a recorded walk along the route instead of GPS. Labelled SIMULATED.
home_pack_error_body: The downloaded walk couldn't be read. Open Courses, delete it and download it again.
tour_not_found: This tour isn't in the offline data.
route_optimised_m: Optimised order: %d m shorter than the listed order
route_optimised_km: Optimised order: %s km shorter than the listed order
route_start_failed: The tour couldn't start. Try again.
route_listed_optimal: The listed order is already the shortest walk.
route_computed: Order computed on this phone in %1$d ms (%2$s).
route_demo_note: Demo walk: your location is simulated along the recorded route.
byg_headphones_body: The guide talks as you walk.
byg_volume_body: Turn it up enough to hear the guide over the street.
byg_test_line_text: Hello, I'm your guide. If you can hear me clearly, we're ready.
byg_lock_title: Eyes on the city, not the screen.
byg_lock_body: I'll keep talking and tell you where to look.
byg_text_notif_body: You'll feel a vibration and see a note at each stop.
byg_footnote: While the tour runs, CityTour uses your location even when the screen is off. You'll see a system notification. Stop any time from the app or the notification.
err_perm_denied: CityTour needs your location to know when you reach each stop.
err_perm_approx: Turn on precise location. Approximate location is accurate only to about 5 km, which isn't enough to find a doorway.
err_loc_switch_off: Location is off for this phone.
err_loc_nofix: Waiting for GPS… Step into the open sky.
err_loc_lost: GPS lost for a moment. Keep going towards the next stop.
err_loc_out_of_area: You're far from %s. Start from the first stop, or try a demo walk.
err_loc_out_of_area_any: You're far from this tour. Start from the first stop, or try a demo walk.
err_tts_init: Voice isn't available on this device. Stories appear as text.
err_voice_unavailable: The English voice isn't installed. The Chinese voice reads English for now.
err_tts_err: A sentence couldn't be spoken. It's shown as text.
err_audio_interrupt: Paused: another app is using audio.
err_bg_fail: The guide couldn't start in the background. Keep the app open while walking.
err_bg_cancelled: Tour paused: background location stopped when the notification was dismissed.
err_avs_fail: Media controls aren't available. The tour still works.
err_pack: Tour data couldn't be loaded. Reinstall the app.
err_narr_fallback: Showing a shorter description for this place.
err_plan_failed: The route couldn't be planned. Try again.
err_uncaught: Something went wrong, but the tour keeps going.
walk_short_version: Short version · stop for a moment to hear the full story
end_dialog_msg: You've visited %1$d of %2$d stops. You can't resume after ending.
demo_assist_note: Demo assist moves the simulated walker. It only exists in the Demo walk.
voice_text_only_platform: Text only: no studio voice available
voice_download_failed: Couldn't download the voice. Try again later.
voice_strategy_auto: Auto: English voice if installed, else the Chinese voice
lang_en_listen_pl_read: Listen in English, read in Polish
lang_pl_footnote: Polish stories are shown as text on this phone.
about_ai_body: The tour stories were drafted with an AI model (Claude by Anthropic) from Wikipedia, Wikidata and the city's heritage records; every fact is checked against a quoted source. Polish and Chinese versions are machine-translated.
about_wikipedia: Text from Wikipedia (Wikipedia contributors), CC BY-SA 4.0
about_arcgis: Monuments and plaques: the city's municipal open data
about_osrm: Walking routes computed with OSRM from OpenStreetMap data
settings_spoken_directions_note: Short directions at turns between stops.
settings_trigger: Start the story when I'm within
settings_trigger_note: Larger works better in narrow streets where GPS drifts.
settings_demo_walk_note: Replays a recorded walk along the tour's route instead of using GPS. Everything simulated is labelled SIMULATED.
onb1_title: Your guide fits in your pocket
onb1_body: Put your headphones in and keep your eyes on the city. The Historian leads you through it and tells you about each place as you reach it.
onb2_body: You can change this any time.
onb_loc_body: Finds the next stop and knows when you've arrived. Used only while a tour is running.
onb_notif_body: Tells you when you arrive if your screen is off and audio is paused.
onb_footer: Location is used only while a tour is running. Nothing leaves your phone.
onb_visual_a11y: A walking route on a city map, from the first stop to the last
onb_checking_voice: Checking the voices on this phone…
onb_fallback_note: The Chinese voice reads English until the English voice is installed.
summary_simulated: Simulated walk: distances and times come from a recorded route.
summary_empty: You ended before the first stop. The tour is still here when you're ready.
summary_map_a11y: Map of the route you walked.
walk_map_a11y: Map of the route. Next stop %s.
place_basic_note: There is no story for this place yet, only its name.
place_not_found: This place isn't in the offline data.
about_arcgis_terms: Licence terms not published; used for positions and names only, with attribution.
settings_detail_brief_note: Brief: the short version at each stop. Tell me more plays the full story.
settings_detail_standard_note: Standard: the full story when you stop, a short version if you walk past.
settings_detail_deep_note: Deep: the full story at every stop, even if you keep walking.
settings_vibrate_note: A short vibration when you reach a stop or finish the tour.
settings_pack_error: The offline pack couldn't be read.
settings_demo_on_note: On: the next tour you start uses the recorded walk.
settings_demo_running_note: A tour is running. The change applies to the next tour you start.
settings_perm_note: Tap a row to allow it. CityTour asks only for what a tour needs.
about_voice_body: Narration voice by ElevenLabs (AI-generated, voice 'George'). Lines without a recording are rendered by the CityTour server in the same voice; offline they are shown as text.
home_more_courses_sub: Download guided walks for other places
courses_offline: Offline. Showing the last saved list.
courses_offline_empty: Can't reach the course server. Check your connection and try again; downloaded walks still work offline.
courses_unverified: The course list could not be verified, so it is not shown.
courses_play_failed: Couldn't start the walk. Check your connection and try again, or download it for offline use.
home_all_places_get: Download every place in the city to explore the map
home_all_places_get_size: Download every place in the city (%s) to explore the map
home_all_places_failed: Couldn't download the places. Tap to try again.
courses_failed: Download failed. Nothing was changed; Try again continues where it stopped.
courses_switch_failed: This course could not be opened. The previous one stays in use.
courses_tour_running: End the current tour to switch courses.
courses_delete_msg: It can be downloaded again later.
settings_online_voice_note: Sentences without a recording are fetched from the CityTour server (within 2.5 s) and kept on the phone. Off or offline: they are shown as text.
widget_desc: Your next stop, distance and progress during a tour.
home_empty_body: Play a walk now, or download it to use offline.
courses_no_server_note: This build has no course server, so no walk can be downloaded.
courses_delete_active_msg: This is the walk in use. Without it the app has no walk until you download one again.
courses_empty: No walks are published on the server yet.
about_cover_changes: Cropped to 16:10 and resized by the CityTour team; shared under the same licence.
home_demo_a11y: Demo walk: replays a recorded walk instead of GPS, labelled SIMULATED
home_no_demo: This walk has no demo track. Use Start to walk it.
home_start_failed: Couldn't start the walk. Check your connection and try again.
home_remove_title: Remove this walk from the device?
